annotations.text:
The chosen direction, in the dark palette.

Home: decisions first, then what is worth a look, then system health, with a live strip for running work.
Plan reviewer: code-review shaped, the zoom ladder inside one plan.
Jobs: every batch workload live, the rate budget by priority class, recent runs.
Failed run: a run is a dataset whose rows are its failures; drill from error class to one item and what it means.

All numbers are sample data. The decisions, assumptions, and the database additions this implies are in the session notes.

Read this board first.

Every view the design names (corpus, plans, review queue, masking, gate, audit) is the same shape: an account-scoped dataset, viewed at a zoom level, sliced by a few dimensions, drilled to rows, with a decision attached to two of them.

The three paths below differ only in what the UI is organized around. All three share this ladder and this map.

Path A · Console
Organized around the data sources: one page per view, exactly as ADR-0021 lists them.

Case for it: familiar, literal, nothing clever to get wrong, cheapest first version, and the fallback if the M3 budget is tight.

Tradeoff: drill-down is built per page and drifts; growth is linear in pages; the plan page is a form with a table, not a review.

Path B · Explorer
Organized around one query model: dataset × group-by × level × filters, with the six views as saved lenses and verbs attached to row types.

Case for it: one mechanism for every view, present and future. Calendar, a second account, audit-by-actor all arrive as registry entries. Analysis is first-class everywhere.

Tradeoff: generic surfaces go bland and strain on the one screen that matters (label ops have no home in a ladder). The read API becomes a small query engine that must stay bounded by a registry.

Path C · Review Desk
Chosen on 2026-09-10. The dark deliverable is on the ui page; these are the light sketches it was chosen from.

Organized around the operator's work: what awaits a decision, what is worth a look, how the system is doing. The plan reviewer borrows the shape of code review. Underneath, Path B's dataset endpoint is the engine every analysis view reads through.
